description: Mengedit gambar dari file lokal atau link https (misalnya tambah logo, ganti latar). Edits or combines 1-4 reference images (local paths or https URLs) following the prompt and saves the result locally. To keep editing, pass the previous result path again. Models: gpt-image-2.5 (max 4), nano-banana-pro (max 4). Every call is paid.

filename.description: Optional file name (no folder). Existing files are never overwritten.

images.description: Absolute local paths (.png/.jpg/.jpeg/.webp, max 20 MB) or https URLs. Order matters: the first is the main image.

prompt.description: The change to make, e.g. "Put the logo from the second image on the mug in the first image".

quality.description: gpt-image only. Default high (most detail, same price per image).

size.description: Optional output size, e.g. 1024x1024, 1536x1024, 1024x1536. Leave empty for the model default.

name: edit_image
title: Edit gambar / Edit image
